AttentionOut.description:
Recent P1/P2 events on holdings/watchlist. papi keeps no read/ack state, so the client tracks
seen-ness (by ``id`` / ``published_key``).
AttentionOut.title: AttentionOut

ErrorOut.description: Body of every 4xx/404 of this API (FastAPI's ``HTTPException`` shape).
ErrorOut.title: ErrorOut

FeedItem.description: One classified disclosure (event) as shown in the tape; the raw ``payload`` is only in the detail.
FeedItem.title: FeedItem

PriceBarOut.description: Daily bar; ``open/high/low/volume`` are null where the source only provides a close (e.g. funds).
PriceBarOut.title: PriceBarOut

ShareCapitalOut.description: From KAP ``sermaye`` pages; every field is null until ``papi kap capital`` has fetched the issuer.

get.description: Stored source bytes (attachments, original HTML/PDF) from the raw store.
Dashboard short poll: ``?after=<cursor>`` plus the feed's filter/sort parameters.

Events with payloads. Query: code, ticker, family, scope (holdings|watchlist|mine|all, default all),
materiality_gte, priority, from, to (Istanbul dates), as_of (ISO time), limit.

Disclosure tape. Page back with ``before=<next_cursor>``; poll new items with
``after=<newest published_key>`` (inclusive, so the client de-duplicates by ``id``).

parameters.description: ``published_key``: only items published at/after it (live polling)
parameters.name: after

schema.description: ``published_key``: only items published at/after it (live polling)
schema.title: After

get.description: Daily bars (default: the last 365 days) with disclosure and transaction markers for the chart.

Daily portfolio value reconstructed from the transaction ledger x daily closes (last known close is
carried over days without a bar). ``return_index`` is a price-return index (flows excluded).

Command-palette search: instruments/issuers (holdings first, then watchlist, then by match
quality) and disclosures (full text, best first).
Cheap service status (no launchctl, no network): lock, heartbeat, KAP poll lag, jobs, governor.

SSE: event.classified, analysis.completed, forecast.created, disclosure.revised (08 §1).

Resume point: the ``Last-Event-ID`` header wins over ``?after=``. A comment ping every 15 s detects
half-open connections.

The Today page in one call. papi stores no read/ack state, so ``attention`` returns every P1/P2
event on holdings/watchlist of the last 48 h and the client tracks what the user has seen.
